inputs.description: Select the native disk to replace. D contains the DOCTOR database.
The selected native disk will be overwritten without a backup. Save its contents first; D contains the DOCTOR database. Pico flash is not changed.

Confirm only the flashing Pico 2 W is connected by USB, isolated from the Z80 board, with 3.3 V ISP wiring and no buzzer/I2C loads. It is safe to interrupt its running firmware for automatic reboot/flashing. Typing P later erases the ATtiny85.

Confirm the ATtiny85 was transferred with both boards off, with 3.3 V I2C/LED/piezo wiring and no ISP leads. Only the testing Pimoroni Pico Plus 2 W is connected by USB, isolated from the Z80 board. It is safe to interrupt its running firmware for automatic reboot/flashing.
Boot package and all Drive A files will be replaced without backups. Firmware, B-D and settings are preserved. Confirm saved work, safe force interruption, and external +5 V before USB.
Confirm it is safe to interrupt the current firmware, all fitted ICs have external +5 V before USB, and you intend to force replace firmware with the Phase 6 scope diagnostic.
All Pico disks A-D and the boot package will be replaced from staged Altair imports without backups, including the current D database. Confirm saved CP/M work and external +5 V before USB.
Selected disks will be overwritten with no backups. Confirm external +5 V is applied before USB and CP/M work is saved.
Confirm external +5 V is applied before USB, CP/M work is saved, and it is safe to force-replace the current firmware with Phase 10.
USB serial number of the intended Pico (picotool info in BOOTSEL).
Confirm phase hardware prerequisites, saved work, and safe interruption for force flashing. No running-phase check. Populated board: external +5 V before USB; initial Phase 1: Pico off breadboard.
ALL flash, disks and ENV will be replaced without backups. Confirm phase prerequisites, saved work, safe force interruption and external +5 V before USB.
Firmware, boot package and drive A will be replaced without backups. Confirm saved work, safe force interruption and external +5 V before USB.
Phase 9 firmware: diagnostic for bring-up tests; automatic loader after tests pass.
